messages:
nina: running the LlamaIndex Next starter in the onboarding lab and hit a weird auth+retry behavior when creating embeddings in parallel. demo breaks for new users.

nina: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-llamaindex-starter (branch: workshop-parallel). Steps: npm run dev, open /playground, hit 'embed docs' quickly 3x. One of the requests returns 401 and the JS SDK retries for a long time; UI shows spinner forever.

omar: ouch. do you have logs from the browser console and server?

nina: server: POST /api/embeddings 200, 401, 200. client: redwood-sdk: attempt retry 1
redwood-sdk: attempt retry 2
redwood-sdk: exhausted retries, but fetch never resolves (stream path?).

kyle: any chance the token refresh race is hitting the edge runtime and leaving a dangling fetch? seen similar with keepalive + streaming.

nina: looks related. I noticed that when multiple embed batches start at same time, the SDK triggers a refresh and both inflight calls try to reuse the old token before the mutex resolves. one call eventually succeeds, others hang.

jen: reproducible? could be our middleware not honoring AbortController when refresh triggers. post a small repro script please.

nina: small repro (browser-like curl loop):
```bash
# emulate 3 parallel client calls
for i in 1 2 3; do 
  curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/embeddings -d '{"texts":["a","b","c"]}' &
done
wait
```

nina: workaround for the workshop: set REDWOOD_SDK_SERIALIZE_EMB=1 in .env to force client-side serialization. UX hits throughput but at least it works for newbies.

omar: ok we should ship a proper fix in SDK. filing RED-DEVEX-4300. jen can you own sample update to set the env and add a note to README to avoid confusion during workshops?

jen: on it. will open a tiny PR that documents the env, adds the repro snippet, and points to the SDK issue. will also add a test in devex/eval-harness that simulates parallel embedding calls and fails if client hangs.

kyle: SDK fix idea: ensure token refresh is fully awaited by all in-flight callers, and ensure any fetches honor AbortController if refresh fails. also consider a small jittered backoff for concurrent refresh attempts.

deploy-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4300 "JS SDK: parallel embedding calls cause token-refresh hang in Next starter" (assignee: kyle).

nina: thanks all. this was the exact friction we saw in the live lab yesterday; good to get a small mitigation in the sample and a proper SDK fix in flight.

jen: PR #128 in samples incoming with README note and .env change. will link SDK PR when available.
